geometry_edits.rationale: Retype the dominant macro from cantilever to split-wing so the current solid can preserve ancestry while gaining a public seam at ground.
Orient the split along the long axis to respond to the frontage edge and create a clear entry figure.
Introduce a controlled void that can operate as a usable public seam rather than a mere notch.
Preserve a continuous anchored base so the edited form remains coherent and programmatically legible at the ground plane.
Keep the ground element substantial enough to support an active street threshold.

graph_edits.rationale: Convert the sealed cantilevered top into a split-wing/public-seam condition so the mass can open toward the access edge while preserving the dominant gesture.
Split along the long axis to create a legible street-facing gap and maintain a single dominant hierarchy.
Open a bounded public seam that can read as usable entry space rather than decorative subtraction.
Keep a grounded base datum so the composition remains one building with an active threshold.
Strengthen the base contact to support neighborhood-living frontage and reduce the impression of a sealed sculptural block.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent dominant mass across the four views, with a clear stepped/cantilevered upper condition and no obvious view-to-view collisions, so gesture and repair integrity are decent. However, it still behaves like a compact sealed block rather than a neighborhood living building: the public void is weak, the blue frontage edge is not convincingly answered by an entry seam/court/undercut, and the section does not yet express an active ground threshold or programmatic public sequence. The silhouette is competent but still somewhat generic and box-like, and the massing does not yet resonate strongly with the street-building references enough to pass program_fit_hard_pass.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This reference is tower-like and much more vertical than the candidate; the candidate currently lacks the program-appropriate active ground/public threshold logic.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A stepped/tapered upper mass can read as a coherent urban gesture when it preserves a clear base and a single dominant volume.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: High-rise office typology; transfer the controlled deformation principle only, not the tall tower program.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A slender, slightly torqued or slumped profile can give hierarchy to a single mass while keeping one legible main figure.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This is low horizontal retail/cafe massing; the candidate needs a more explicit public void or ground seam to match the neighborhood-living brief.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A modest street-facing mass with a readable entry edge and canopy-like ground response supports neighborhood living better than a sealed object.

warnings: Parcel containment appears plausible in the images, but the mass does not sufficiently use the parcel to generate a public figure.
The verified primary road frontage is not given a strong legible ground response; the access relation feels muted.
Program fit fails because the mass lacks an active ground threshold and meaningful public void for neighborhood_living.
